reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: Easily one of the worst music transfer apps I've used. Basically useless unless you spend money on it. Tunemymusic 900x better

reviews.title: Simply did not work
reviews.text: I bought the pro version thinking it might work better, but it did not.  It transferred 1272 albums from Apple Music to YouTube Music, but then want me to go back and fix 1269 albums.  I then tried tunemymusic and it worked first time.

reviews.title: Free version basically unusable
reviews.text: This app used to be great, easy to use, and the free version was good enough for transferring most of your music playlist. Now everything except transferring a few songs is locked behind pro. Why would I pay a subscription for a sync I do maybe once a year. At this point, charge me a one time use option to transfer everything

reviews.title: Application needs an update
reviews.text: Matches or failures to match are questionable and app continually crashes. ChatGPT can do this with far less stress, save your money.

reviews.title: Failed pretty badly
reviews.text: Paid for pro to transfer 1600 songs, and began the matchmaking process. It failed 1400 songs, despite the few that I checked having pretty clear matches when manually searching. So I would’ve had to go through all those 1400 songs manually regardless, defeating the purpose of the app. I’m sure it works well on small playlists, since it didn’t fail to match all the songs (hence the two stars instead of one) but it did not work for me, so I’m pretty disappointed and wasted a few bucks.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work and being ignored
reviews.text:
Been trying and trying with this app. Works amazing when you first transfer playlists across but when when you ask it to monitor them it does nothing just new songs go into ‘pending shifts’ when I go onto the app. 
Have tried reaching out for support multiple times and have been continually ignored. Got a response once after twenty days and then never again.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work and support requests ignored
reviews.text: I got the paid option to copy my full Apple Music library to my Spotify yet it keeps failing. I have reached out to their support team and just get ignored. Very disappointed
